name: carplay_tilt
what: CCarPlayActivity::handleControllerInput (0x43d42c) sends the iDrive controller tilts to CarPlay as knob directions (up/down/left/right fields of AuxIn CarPlayControllerInput, which NBTMediaMainApp turns into the CarPlay knob HID). The stock HMI hard-codes those four fields to 0: tilt up/down are dropped, tilt left goes out as Back and tilt right is left to the HMI (side panel).
how: 0x43d494..0x43d49c: the key filter (only rotate 0xd/0xe) becomes 9..14 (tilt up 9, down 10, left 11, right 12, rotate 13/14)
0x43d688: tilt left (0xb) no longer sets the Back field (Back stays on the BACK key, 2)
0x43dd14: skips the trace printf of this function, so its 16 instructions at 0x43d634 are free
0x43d634..0x43d664: zero the four direction words on the stack, store "pressed" in the one of key-9 (0..3), Voice field as before, jump to the send call 0x43d6d4
0x43d6b0: jump to that code instead of the original argument setup
